name: 管理员
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE new collectible character-card illustration, portrait 9:16, single continuous full-bleed painting, highest available native resolution. Character: 管理员 from Arknights: Endfield, for the unofficial fan game Talos / 塔卫牌局.
Input image 1 is the canonical APPEARANCE reference. Input image 2 is the approved existing normal card, for identity and clothing continuity ONLY. Create a genuinely NEW scene, pose, expression and camera arrangement; do not copy either layout. Preserve hairstyle, face shape, species features, outfit layers, color identifiers, accessories and canonical equipment. Do not invent a different costume, weapon or extra animal ears.
Quality tier: normal. Style: Clean precise 2D anime cel illustration with crisp expressive drawing, economical two-step shadows, restrained palette and a simple graphic background. Finished and attractive but deliberately modest in background detail and material rendering. No watercolor, no oil painting, no cinematic particles.
Composition and action: three-quarter half-body portrait, body pivoted forward in a ready stance, canonical equipment resting safely; no extreme foreshortening.
Scene and palette: a restrained slate and muted vermilion preparation area, two broad architectural planes, slanting late light. This is an original fan-art moment, not an assertion of an official story event. 
Facial acting: alert resolve with a firm mouth and focused brows, no generic smile; let personality appear through the gaze and posture. Character-specific personality reference: restrained curiosity conveyed by a small head tilt and relaxed shoulders; preserve all canonical face coverings. Coordinate eyebrows, eyelids, pupils, cheeks and mouth so the expression is alive and individual. Do not paste the same smile on every card. Preserve the opaque black angular visor over the eyes exactly; do not invent visible eyes. Facial acting must use the visible mouth, head angle and shoulders. Keep the same canonical gender presentation.
Natural anatomy and hands, clean readable silhouette, harmonious proportions, detailed face with the sharpest local focus. Tasteful nonsexual framing. No lettering, symbols masquerading as text, signature, watermark, logo, card border or UI. Do not print rarity or resolution. This image will be separately super-resolved to 2160x3840, with original size preserved in metadata.
Priority composition correction: Stand upright in a graphite-red industrial corridor, right-facing profile with head sharply turned toward the viewer, long coat lifted by a small breeze, one open gloved palm held at waist level as if directing the team to halt. Serious straight lips, no smile. Do not sit. No mineral, rock, cup, plants or hand touching the cheek. Clean 2D cel shading with broad simple shadow shapes, not the painterly rendering of image 2.

visualQA.notes: Identity, expression variety, anatomy, framing and tier composition checked.
